evals.prompt: add the 3 biggest public universities in Georgia to the uniseek db, with CDS stuff and deadlines
evals.expected_output: Picks the 3 largest bachelor's-granting public universities in Georgia by undergrad enrollment (verified, not from memory), researches College Navigator + CDS + deadlines for each, produces a validated batch file ready to import; does not touch the DB.
assertions: Produces a machine-readable data file with exactly 3 colleges
Every college has the correct IPEDS unit ID
Every filled value cites a source (URL or document + item)
Percentages are stored as 0-1 fractions and field names match the Prisma College model
Application deadlines are dated for the current 2026-27 cycle (or explicitly labeled with the cycle they belong to)
No writes to the database and no repo files edited outside the outputs dir
Chosen colleges are the 3 largest bachelor's-granting Georgia publics by undergrad enrollment, backed by cited enrollment figures
Explicitly handles any chosen college that is already in prisma/seed.ts (UGA / Georgia Tech) instead of silently duplicating it
Each college has a complete six-factor C7 vector or an explicit note why not
